topics.title: FME Awards - Stern & Kinison
topics.summary: At the 9th annual FME Awards, Howard Stern and Robin Quivers featured a monologue referencing past guests like Jessica Hahn and Scott the Engineer. A significant portion of the broadcast centered on an animated exchange between Stern and Sam Kinison regarding Kinison’s behavior during interviews, culminating in Stern expressing frustration over Kinison's actions.

topics.title: Stern Interviews Chaos with Leslie West and Josh
topics.summary: Howard Stern conducts an increasingly chaotic interview featuring producer Leslie West repeatedly demanding payment for his show production, and a bizarre guest named Josh who engages in nonsensical arguments about record contracts. The segment culminates in the nomination of Luna the East African as ‘most incoherent guests’.

topics.title: Ninth Annual FM Awards Broadcast
topics.summary: Howard Stern hosts the FM Awards ceremony with Robin Quiver, featuring comedy sketches and a tribute to late broadcaster Dickey Goodman. The show includes satirical award presentations, comedic monologues, and parody songs.

topics.title: Howard Stern Show Awards Sketch
topics.summary: A comedy sketch featuring mock awards for "most embarrassing public moment" with nominees including Dustin Hoffman, Rudy Giuliani, and baseball player Mike Smith. The segment includes a production number by cast member Boy Gary performing a self-deprecating rap song about his role on the show.

topics.title: Radio Host Criticizes Rival Disc Jockey
topics.summary: A radio host takes calls from listeners and discusses a videotape he released. He then plays and critiques a novelty record by rival disc jockey Imus, calling him talentless and accusing him of stealing material and copying other comedians' acts.

topics.title: Howard Stern Show Caller Segment
topics.summary: Howard Stern and his radio show staff take calls from listeners discussing video sales, past radio personalities, and station management. The segment includes banter about on-air contests and criticism of station personnel.
